scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,admin -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w admin
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web
scripts.build:admin: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules server/dist web/dist admin/dist shared/dist
